z-score.def: The number of standard deviations a value is above or below the mean: $z = \frac{x - \bar{x}}{s}$ ($\frac{x - \mu}{\sigma}$ for a population). Positive is above the mean, negative below; it has no units.

relative-position.def: Where a value stands within its own distribution, measured by a percentile or a z-score, so values from different distributions can be compared.
